en.title: Range Increments to Make Server Power Non-Decreasing
en.description:
One operation chooses any contiguous range and increases each element in it by x≥0, at a cost of x rather than the range length times x. Find the minimum total cost to make the array non-decreasing.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O and judging; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n power values (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: 4→1 drops by 3 and 6→2 drops by 4, so the cost is 7. Example 2: already non-decreasing, cost 0. Example 3: add 4 to the last two elements together, giving 5, 5, 5, cost 4.
